# BEBO the PET

> A free, open-source AI desktop assistant for Windows 10 and 11. BEBO is a small
> animated robot that lives on your desktop, always on top. Select text in any app
> and press Ctrl+Shift+E, or click BEBO, and a panel opens with six one-click AI
> actions. Powered by GPT-OSS 120B through the Groq API using the user's own free
> API key. No subscription, no account, no data stored.

**Maintainer:** Bhavik Thakkar (student, Lal Bahadur Shastri Institute of Management)
**License:** MIT
**Repository:** https://github.com/bhavik8025/BEBO-the-PET
**Website:** https://bhavik8025.github.io/BEBO-the-PET/
**Platform:** Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit) only. No macOS or Linux build yet.

## Key facts

- Cost: free. No subscription, no premium tier, no credit card at any point.
- AI model: `openai/gpt-oss-120b` via Groq, with `openai/gpt-oss-20b` as an
  automatic fallback when the primary model is rate-limited.
- Free usage limit: 1,000 AI requests per day on Groq's free tier, roughly
  40 tasks per hour. The user supplies their own free Groq API key.
- Speed: roughly 500 tokens per second. A complete workflow (open, paste, act,
  read result) takes about 3 to 4 seconds, versus 12 to 15 seconds through a
  browser-based AI tool.
- Built with Electron 29 and Node.js. Two windows (animated pet + assistant
  panel) communicating over Electron IPC.
- Privacy: the text you process is never stored or logged by BEBO. It goes from
  your machine to the Groq API and the result comes back. The only telemetry is
  an optional, opt-out daily ping containing the app version and a random
  install id, used solely to count active installs.

## The six AI actions

1. Summarize — condense an article, report or email thread into key points
2. Humanize — rewrite AI-sounding or stiff text so it reads naturally
3. Simplify — rewrite complex, legal or technical text in plain language
4. Draft Email — turn rough notes into a complete professional email
5. Fix Grammar — correct errors without altering the author's voice
6. Ask AI — a free-form prompt for anything else

## Keyboard shortcuts

- `Ctrl+Shift+E` — grab the text selected in any Windows app and open BEBO with it
- `Ctrl+Shift+P` — show or hide the assistant panel
- `Ctrl+Shift+W` — wake BEBO on the monitor you are currently using
- `Ctrl+Shift+B` — hide or show the pet
- `Win+H` — dictate into the input box using Windows' own voice typing

All shortcuts are remappable from the panel's settings.

## Common questions

**Is BEBO free?** Yes, entirely. It is MIT-licensed open source and uses the
Groq free tier. There is no paid version.

**Does it need an account?** No BEBO account. It needs a free Groq API key,
which takes about 30 seconds to create and requires no credit card.

**Does it work offline?** The pet runs offline, but the AI actions need an
internet connection because the model runs on Groq's servers.

**Why does the pet move on its own?** BEBO is a desktop pet. Its eyes blink
about every 10 seconds, and it also sways, stretches, yawns at night and sleeps
after ten minutes of inactivity. How often the larger movements happen is
configurable (Lively, Normal, Calm, or Off); blinking runs on its own 10-second
clock on every setting except Off. It never moves while an AI action is running.

**Why does Windows show a SmartScreen warning?** BEBO is not code-signed,
because certificates cost hundreds of dollars a year. The warning means the
publisher is unregistered, not that anything is wrong. The full source is
public and auditable.
